jobs_results.title: Senior Portfolio Accountant
jobs_results.description:
Company Overview 




At Opus, we grow together. Our team of bold thinkers and passionate doers is united by a shared mission to tackle meaningful challenges. Our culture of trust and belonging has earned us the Great Place to Work certification in four countries, based entirely on team feedback. It reflects our commitment to fairness, pride credibility and camaraderie, and reinforces what we believe: when people feel valued, they do their best work.




Key Responsibilities




Perform and oversee portfolio accounting activities, monitoring daily and month-end deliverables, reviewing outputs for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.Review and maintain reconciliations and controls, ensuring discrepancies are identified, investigated, and resolved in a timely manner.Act as a technical resource for accounting and operational issues, independently investigating and resolving discrepancies, root causes, and system or data-related issues.Support projects and initiatives such as system enhancements, process changes, or remediation of recurring issues.Partner with internal teams to resolve complex or non-standard scenarios, applying judgment rather than relying solely on precedent.Serve as a point of support for client inquiries, either directly or in partnership with client service teams, providing clear explanations of results, drivers, and issues.Critically evaluate existing processes, controls, and workflows to identify inefficiencies or gaps, and proactively raise improvement ideas that lead to practical enhancements


Key Qualifications & Competencies 




Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related analytically focused field (such as Business, Mathematics, Computer Science), or equivalent combination of education and experience.Minimum of 3 years of experience in the fund administration industry, with prior experience supporting investment funds or portfoliosBroad exposure to multiple financial instrument types, with the ability to interpret investment activity and analyze drivers of portfolio- and security-level P&L.Portfolio Accounting Expertise: An understanding of financial instruments such as equities, bonds or derivatives, security setups, trade capture, corporate actions, and market data managementStrong technical aptitude, including the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, support projects, and serve as a subject-matter resource.Client-facing experience or close collaboration with client service teams, supporting communication, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.Proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement, including identifying inefficiencies, raising issues, and contributing ideas to improve processes and outcomes.

jobs_results.title: Associate Accountant (CA Freshers)
jobs_results.description:
About BDO India

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.




The Opportunity

We are looking for a newly qualified Chartered Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team. The role will provide exposure to financial accounting, taxation and statutory compliance, audit coordination, reconciliations, and MIS reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, analytical ability, and a keen eye for detail.




Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting

Assist in preparing and finalizing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS).Support month-end and year-end closing activities.Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records and financial information.


Taxation & Compliance

Assist in ensuring timely compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.Support preparation and filing of GST, TDS, and Income Tax returns.Assist in maintaining tax records and supporting documentation.


Audits

Support internal, statutory, and tax audits.Coordinate with external auditors and provide required schedules, documents, and supporting information.Assist in addressing audit queries and closing audit requirements.


Reconciliations

Perform regular bank, vendor, and customer ledger reconciliations.Identify discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.Ensure reconciliation statements and supporting documentation are properly maintained.


MIS Reporting

Prepare accurate and timely MIS reports for management review.Assist in variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and prior-period results.Highlight significant variances and provide relevant insights to support decision-making.


Qualifications:

CA Fresher / Newly Qualified Chartered Accountant.Strong academic and accounting fundamentals.Candidates with relevant articleship exposure in financial accounting, taxation, audit, and compliance will be preferred.Should demonstrate a willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.Basic knowledge of Ind AS, GST, TDS, and Income Tax.Strong analytical and numerical skills.Good command of MS Excel and accounting/ERP systems.High attention to detail and accuracy.Ability to work independently as well as collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.

jobs_results.title: Fund Services - Senior Fund Accountant
jobs_results.description:
Job Description 
 
 About Citco: 
 
 The market leader. The premier provider. The best in thebusiness. At Citco, we've been the front-runner in our field since ourincorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sectoritself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate andexpand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. Fromworking exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporationsand private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classesand geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we'll only maintain aswe move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want toplay at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say:Welcome to Citco. 
 
 About the Team & Business Line:  
 
 Fund Administration is Citco's core business, and ouralternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry's mostrespected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions meansour people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience. 
 
 Responsibilities 

Your Role:  
  Performing the administration of and any services pursuant to administration agreements in respect of a portfolio of hedge fund clients; Consolidation and validation review of functional handovers across teams and locations Preparation and/or review of Net Asset Value calculations, financial statements and associated reports Valuation of hedge fund portfolio holdings Analysis of fund performance and prepare performance/P and L related reports Demonstrate ownership of assigned work and ensure timely completion, in line with demanding client service agreements Escalate priority issues to supervisor and/or assistant vice president in a timely and detailed manner Maintaining day-to-day relationships with Citco Internal COE and non-COE teams including Operational Support, Middle Office, Pricing, Investor Relations and Relationship Management Fund Accounting teams  Support queries from external parties, including clients, auditors and other advisors  Maintain a current and thorough understanding of applicable best practice policies and client specific agreements. Support training of new fund accountants and on-boarding of new clients and/or funds to Citco Assist supervisor and/or assistant vice president as required Contribute to team and/or departmental initiatives  
 Qualifications 

About You: 
  Degree qualified in Accounting or Finance related area and/or studying for a professional accounting qualification 2-3 years of experience in Financial Services with high volume operational environment and/ or hedge fund industry is an advantage Display an active interest in the financial markets and hedge fund industry Strong financial and/or accounting and analytical skills Proficient in Microsoft Applications (Word, Excel etc.)  
 Our Benefits 
 
 Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location. 
 
 We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect. 
 
 Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

jobs_results.title: Accountant (Mumbai Based) QBO
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking candidates who work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy. Accountants can expect to work with large amounts of numerical data, handle multiple tasks with deadlines, and provide transparent and complete reports to management.




We are looking for candidates who can work on their own with responsibility & little supervision. Candidates will be mostly working on clients located in USA & will have to learn new accounting softwares. If candidate has experience in USA accounting please bring last prepared sample detailed general ledger to interview without any identifying data for the ledger.




You should have a firm grasp of accounting and financial practices and regulations and possess strong computer and verbal and written communication skills.




To ensure success, Accountants should be prompt, honest detail-oriented, professional, and analytical. Top candidates will have excellent presentation skills with the ability to successfully communicate complex quantitative data to decision makers.




We are looking for candidates who can work as a team & willing to work occasionally in USA time zone.





PPF & Holiday Policy available. If selected a Video interview request with personality test will be shared.




Responsibilities




Complying with all company, local, state, and federal accounting and financial regulations.
Compiling, analyzing, and reporting financial data.
Creating periodic reports, such as balance sheets, profit & loss statements, etc.
Presenting data to managers, investors, and other entities.
Maintaining accurate financial records.
Performing audits and resolving discrepancies.
Computing taxes.
Keeping informed about current legislation relating to finance and accounting.
Assisting management in the decision-making process by preparing budgets and financial forecasts.
Client's are primarily located in USA


Requirements




Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field.
More education or experience may be preferred.
Special licenses or certification may be required. (CA, CFA, Inter CA preferred)
Strong analytical, communication, and computer skills.
Understanding of mathematics and accounting and financial processes.
Ethical behaviour.
Attention to detail.
QuickBooks Online or Xero experience.
DrakeTax or Intuit pro connect experience.
Strong Excel Skills - Should be able to demonstrate V-lookup function.
7+ years working experience preferred.

jobs_results.title: Accountant- Zoho Specialist
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced Accountant with deep expertise in the Zoho ecosystem to manage accounting operations while optimizing and integrating Zoho applications across the organization. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, hands-on experience with Zoho Finance applications, and the ability to configure workflows, automate processes, and integrate multiple Zoho modules to improve operational efficiency.

Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting.
Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, and other statutory and regulatory requirements.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and other stakeholders during audits and statutory filings.
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely month-end and year-end closing activities.

Zoho Administration & Integration

Configure, manage, and maintain Zoho Finance applications, including:
Zoho Books
Zoho Inventory
Zoho Expense
Zoho Payroll
Zoho Billing (if applicable)
Zoho Analytics

Zoho CRM
Zoho Flow
Zoho Creator (preferred)
Third-party applications, payment gateways, banking platforms, ERP systems, and e-commerce platforms as required.
Design and implement automated workflows using Zoho Flow and Deluge scripting (preferred).
Customize forms, reports, dashboards, approval workflows, user roles, and permissions.
Monitor integrations to ensure seamless data flow and troubleshoot issues proactively.

Required Skills: Accounting

Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.
Sound knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian taxation requirements.
Experience in budgeting, reconciliations, and compliance.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Zoho Expertise

Hands-on experience with Zoho Books and other Zoho Finance applications.
Strong knowledge of Zoho Flow for workflow automation.
Experience integrating multiple Zoho applications.
Ability to configure custom workflows, reports, dashboards, and automation.
Knowledge of Deluge scripting is an added advantage.
Experience with APIs and third-party integrations is desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Effective communication and stakeholder management.
Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on automation and continuous improvement.
Collaborative approach to working with finance, operations, sales, and IT teams.

Pay: ₹28,597.69 - ₹45,000.00 per month
